messages:
maya: Quick sync — customer asks keep coming for a single canonical tool schema and a deterministic call/result envelope. We need to decide MVP surface and launch criteria.
kevin: high-level ask from Beta banks: strict schema validation server-side, typed params, and stable result shape. They want easy retry semantics.
sophie: for ML folks, preserving original model evidence (trace/id + token offsets) is useful for audits. That pushes shape complexity.
jared: from UX, we want the simplest call/response JSON that tools can render without special parsing. Prefer: name, args, status, result.
leo: engineering/prio tradeoff: minimal viable should support: required params, optional params, and a unified error object. Anything beyond that delays ship.
maya: proposal: MVP = tool manifest + call instruction + result envelope. Manifest includes name, description, params schema (JSON Schema or simplified typed list). Call has tool_name + arg payload. Result has status, output, error.
kevin: can we show an exact minimal example?
maya: sure.
kevin: ```
{"tool_manifest": {
  "name": "lookup_customer",
  "description": "Return customer record by id",
  "params": [{"name":"customer_id","type":"string","required":true}]
},
"call": {"tool_name":"lookup_customer","args":{"customer_id":"C123"}},
"result": {"status":"ok","output":{"id":"C123","name":"ACME"}}}
```
sophie: looks fine but add a result.metadata.trace_id for lineage.
jared: also include a small note for UI: result.output should be a flat object or simple array — nested blobs make render messy.
leo: error shape? We should standardize codes so SDKs can handle. E.g. {code, message, retriable}.
maya: agree. add: {"result": {"status":"error","error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"...","retriable":false}}} as canonical.
kevin: about schema language — JSON Schema is expressive but heavy. Suggest a compact typed list we can expand to JSON Schema later. Example: [{name, type, required, enum?}]
sophie: must support file/blob references for tools that accept attachments. Put a param.type = "file" and an id referencing an uploaded object.
maya: launch criteria draft: (1) server validates incoming calls against manifest for required fields; (2) result envelope includes status + standardized error; (3) SDKs map errors to exceptions; (4) tracing id present.
leo: timeline: can we get validation + error envelope in 2 sprints? + SDK mapping in next sprint.
kevin: yes, infra can add schema validation middleware in 2 sprints, but file param support adds more infra work (signed URLs). Keep file support for phase 2.
jared: customer-facing docs and examples required for GA. I can own docs if product ok.
maya: ok docs owner = jared. Next: decide whether tool_manifest is stored globally or per-model. Beta customers expect per-deployment manifests.
sophie: prefer per-deployment (or per-model) so different models expose different tool capabilities.
leo: agree; design routing needs to check manifest for the target model. We'll need an index.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: schema-validator service queued for staging deploy Thu 03:00 UTC.
maya: action items: @kevin add compact param schema spec + sample JSON by EOD Thu, @leo create infra ticket for manifest index and routing, @jared start docs outline, @sophie write trace field proposal. We'll reconvene Fri morning.
kevin: noted, will post PR with spec draft.
sophie: will draft trace proposal and edge cases (async calls, partial results).
jared: will sketch docs and examples (web UI + curl).
leo: created infra ticket INF-4237.
maya: thanks all. If anyone wants to push for file support earlier, post customer justification here. Otherwise we go phased. :+1:
